data.body:
[P2] Include callbacks and controls in retirement auditing

The generated inventory contains only invocations and executions. Every shared case creates control objects, and suspension-retry also creates a callback, but neither enters this inventory. Both retirement validators therefore skip their required completion checks; controls are only overwritten with `release`, never deleted. Inventory these resources and require their service completion or deletion receipts before declaring retirement. Cover an unsettled callback and retained control in normalizer tests.
